title: Complementary housing views
purpose: Measure active-reference-set handling when two images provide complementary form and depth evidence.
complexityRationale: Two views jointly define a hollow housing, wall thickness, corner form, and mounting features that no single image fully specifies.

turns.text: Build one open-back housing from these complementary synthetic views. Use the front view for the rounded rectangular face and mounting pattern, and the side view for the 30 mm depth and 3 mm wall.

assets.provenanceNotes: Synthetic front view authored for this complementary-view case.
Synthetic side view authored for this complementary-view case.

requirements.description: The housing is 30 mm deep with a nominal 3 mm wall and an open back.
Current visual verification covers both active complementary references.
The final housing coherently combines the front proportions, corner treatment, mounting pattern, depth, and open-back form.

forbiddenOutcomes.reason: A result covering only one active view or an earlier artifact cannot be finalized.
Conflicts between complementary evidence must remain explicit rather than being silently dropped.

sourceSafety.notes: Both complementary SVG views are synthetic and contain no user evidence.
